tooltips.storageService: File storage is a place where you can store your files. Robots can access these files to perform their tasks

app.welcome: Welcome to the ERP-RPA system! Here is a quick guide to help you get familiar with the main features.
app.home: Home: Displays recent activities and gives quick access to system functions.
app.dashboard: Dashboard: Track overall statistics and performance metrics of the Robot system.
app.studio: Studio: Design environment where you can build and draw workflows.
app.robot: Robot: Manage the list of Robots, assign tasks, and monitor execution processes.
app.integration: Connection: Configure and manage connections with third-party services (ERP, Database, etc.).
app.storage: Storage: Store and manage essential files and documents used in processes.
app.template: Document Template: Design and manage forms and invoices for automatic data extraction and processing.
app.workspace: Workspace: Manage and switch working contexts between different collaboration teams.
app.finish: The guide has ended! You are ready to start using ERP-RPA.

palette.title: Tool Palette
palette.content: This is the BPMN tool palette. You will drag elements from here onto the canvas.

dragTask.title: Drag Task to canvas
dragTask.content: Drag this icon (rectangle) onto the canvas.

dragEnd.title: Drag End Event to canvas
dragEnd.content: Drag this icon (thick circle) onto the canvas to end the process.

modeler.autoAdvance: The tour will automatically advance when you drop it.

connect.title: Connect elements
connect.content: Click an element → an arrow appears → drag it to another element to connect. Let's connect: Start Event → Task → End Event.

nameTask.title: Name the Task
nameTask.content:
Double-click the Task on the canvas to name it.

A clear name makes the process easier to read and generates more accurate robot code.

properties.title: Properties Sidebar
properties.content:
Click the Task on the canvas to open the right sidebar.

The sidebar displays information and allows detailed configuration for each element.

package.title: Select Activity Package
package.content:
In the sidebar, select a suitable Activity Package (e.g., Browser Automation, Data Manipulation...).

Each package contains activities that can be automated.

template.title: Assign Activity Template
template.content:
After selecting the package, choose a specific Activity Template.

Then provide appropriate values for the parameters.

ai.title: Use AI Chatbot
ai.content:
Click this AI Robot button to open the AI Chatbot.

AI can automatically generate BPMN processes from your natural language description.

problems.title: View Problems
problems.content: The "Problems" tab displays errors and warnings in the process. Click here to view details.

logs.title: View Logs
logs.content: The "Logs" tab displays the history and run logs of the Robot. Monitor Logs to know the execution process.

variables.title: Create Variables
variables.content: The "Variables" tab is for declaring variables used in the process. Click it and press "+ Add Variable" to add a new one.
